census-close.notes:
FINAL TIP fe917342a6a1f71052543bd45ff4e342932f4c04 on campaign/batch-census-close (4 commits off origin/main e0987ace, pushed, tree clean). No crates/ touched, so no protocol bump, no zone excursion (compat-registry only), and the C ABI / iOS are untouched. All three of my groups are closed; the post-freeze meter went 15 items / 9 groups -> 12 items / 6 groups.

WHAT LANDED. (1) compat/scenarios/smoke/plugin-runtime-oh-my-tmux.txt + fixtures/oh-my-tmux-runtime.py run oh-my-tmux's prefix y for real on both binaries. The config picks its clipboard tool by `command -v` at config time in six ordered `if -b` jobs at .tmux.conf:130-139, so the fixture pins the branch (fake xsel first on the server PATH, XDG_SESSION_TYPE pinned to x11 so the :134 wl-copy branch cannot win the async race) and re-sources the corpus config. Both sides read back the SAME :131 binding byte for byte from list-keys, a real C-b y on an attached pty client fires it, and both write the same 19 clipboard bytes 4f482d4d592d544d55582d5052454649582d59 with argv `-i -b`, leave the same paste buffer and leave the pane out of mode. The status half asserts both sides' status-left/status-right templates byte for byte after the load and runs the config's own _username helper (the .tmux.conf:1641 form) twice, once as a status-right #() job with status-interval 1 and status on with the client attached, once as a run-shell, each redirected to a file: both answer `demfabris`. Scenario is 4 steps, ran green 4x in a row under other-lane load. (2) census-formats.txt gained `fmt: #P` (both sides answer 0); its header comment now names the owner of each remainder name. (3) format-listing.sh got a comment-only citation update (no assertion changed; the scenario was re-run green anyway).

TMUX_PROGRAM, MEASURED ON BOTH SIDES (this is the measurement the batch asked for). oh-my-tmux's _apply_configuration resolves TMUX_PROGRAM from `readlink /proc/#{pid}/exe` and then validates it by asking that binary for the server pid. BOTH sides pass that validation, so both end up with the server's own executable: the pin with the pinned tmux binary, zz with the zz binary under test (/home/demfabris/dev/zz-gate-target/debug/zz on this run). zz passes because its daemon hands jobs a ZZ_SOCKET pointing at the running server, so a bare `zz display -p '#{l:#{pid}}'` reaches the right daemon. The config therefore NEVER falls back to `command -v tmux`, so the `tmux` wrapper pane.tmux-on-path puts on the pane PATH is not what prefix y runs on either side. TMUX_SOCKET equals #{socket_path} on both. The fixture asserts the executable bit, the pid round trip and the socket equality rather than the two paths, which differ by construction; the raw paths are in the closed record.

TWO FIXTURE LESSONS THE NEXT LANE NEEDS (both in the closed plugins.runtime-paths record and in knowledge/tmux/divergences.md). (a) A job's environment is NOT global_environ alone: environ_for_session copies global_environ and then the session's own environ over it (pin environ.c), and a session created from a client keeps that client's PATH and XDG_SESSION_TYPE. `set-environment -g` alone left `command -v xsel` and the wayland test answering this box's real values inside the `if -b` jobs, so the wl-copy binding kept winning. Anything a plugin resolves through the environment must be set with -g AND with -t on every session, including one the fixture creates afterwards. zz behaves the same way here. (b) NEW, and it silently voids key-driven fixtures: the zz raw TUI client stops reading its stdin once its own pty output fills the buffer. With 82 KB of unread debug-build log spew on the master, prefix d did not detach and a plain `run-shell touch` binding never fired on zz; draining the master in a thread made every one of them fire immediately. The pin has no such threshold at this size. Any future fixture that attaches a zz client and then sends keys MUST drain the master (keys-contract.py already does, incidentally, which is why it was green).

CENSUS REMAINDER, one owner per name, no narrowing: #P was a false positive (only corpus occurrence was the literal prompt text in fixtures/keys-contract.py) and is now expanded; start_time stays undiffable by construction; the five cell formats -> formats.terminal-cells; pane_key_mode -> formats.pane-runtime; the three mode templates -> formats.native-modes (already carried theirs); history_limit -> presentation.native-status (semantic:history-limit-product-default); #T and pane_path -> pane.runtime-facts, whose own scenario proves them, so no #T/pane_path step was added to census-formats.txt as instructed. The batch said terminal-cells/pane-runtime/native-modes already carried their census measurement: only native-modes did, so I appended the measured values to formats.terminal-cells, formats.pane-runtime and presentation.native-status. The closed record carries census.py's output at my tip and I verified it still matches byte for byte after the last commit.

DECISION RECORDED (client theme): relocated semantic:harness-theme-steering into the accepted options.client-terminal-negotiation, added an acceptance clause plus a reason paragraph quoting format-listing.sh's own values (pin: `theme-unsteered` empty and `theme-unsteered-listed` 0 because c->theme is THEME_UNKNOWN and format_cb_client_theme returns NULL; zz: `dark` and 1 from attach; both answer `dark` after the reply), the stance, and the mandated sentence "decided 2026-09-07 by the orchestrator under fabrico's cycle-17 instruction to finish the campaign; reversible". harness.proof-holes closed with a resolution listing all seven holes and where each went.

REGISTRY SUBTLETIES FOR THE INTEGRATOR. compat/tmux-gaps.json's closed[] must stay sorted by id - the tracker rejected my first append until I re-sorted, so a merge that concatenates closed entries will fail the check; regenerate rather than hand-merge. Every commit was made with `python3 compat/tmux-tracker.py check` green and knowledge/tmux/gaps.md regenerated by write-report. No format: item moved, so the zz-mux manifest partition counts were untouched; cargo test -p zz-mux is fully green at the tip (13 result lines, 624 tests, 0 failed). compat/run.sh --check-summary prints "summary current: 250 scenarios, 3078 steps; attached-client PASS at 6edc5c7ec425" at the tip - I did not touch compat/attached-client.sh. Summary rows added/updated: smoke/plugin-runtime-oh-my-tmux (new, 4 steps) and census-formats (39 -> 40 steps).

STALE PROSE THE GATE SHOULD REFRESH, NOT ME: knowledge/tmux/divergences.md's "# Cycle-16 checkpoint" block still lists harness.proof-holes, plugins.runtime-paths and proofs.census-coverage among the open groups. It is explicitly dated as the cycle-16 integration checkpoint and other lanes are closing groups in parallel, so I left it alone and added a new dated "# 2026-09-07: the proof side of cycle 17" section instead; the gate's recomputed checkpoint should replace it. I also added the requested sentence to knowledge/tmux/status-line.md naming compat/status-row.sh for the drawn row and compat/tui-pane-geometry.sh for the geometry, without describing what the client lane changes them to measure.

NO FLAKES SEEN. The new scenario ran green 4 times (once at the tip, then 3 back to back); census-formats and smoke/format-listing each green at the tip. No cargo build in this lane; the only cargo command was the mandated zz-mux gate against /home/demfabris/dev/zz-gate-target. All throwaway probe servers were killed and their dirs and dead socket files removed; the user's default zz socket and the default tmux socket were never dialled by a probe of mine and no pkill/killall was used. Nothing was left open and no slug of mine remains unclosed.

tui-status-menu.notes:
FINAL TIP e8bf4d1b3cf0a15010cdb36bffc5f013ef7dd40a on campaign/batch-tui-status-menu, four commits on origin/main (e0987ace). No protocol bump; nothing wire-reachable touched. zz-client/src/lib.rs gained one re-export (MOUSE_BUTTON_1) — no type change, so include/zz-client.h and the ffi crate are untouched.

GROUP 1, tui.sidebar-auto-hide, CLOSED and moved to closed[]. The registry's diagnosis was wrong and the measurement replaced it. Probed at 80x24 with one pane: with status on the pin gives the pane 23 rows and zz gave 22, with status off zz gave 23, with status 2 zz gave 21 — so zz's status block already spent exactly what the option asks. The missing row was a per-pane header the raw TUI reserved unconditionally (layout.rs PaneRect::content always took a row); the pin reserves it only while pane-border-status is on (window_pane_get_pane_status returns PANE_STATUS_OFF by default). PaneRect now carries PaneBorderStatus and content() follows layout_fix_panes. The pane title that rode in that header now lives only in the sidebar and the " grid WxH (owned elsewhere) " diagnostic is gone — that is the visible cost of the product decision, recorded as such. status-left: the old clause DOES NOT REPRODUCE at e0987ace — at 80 and at 100 columns the raw TUI's row is character-for-character the pin's, LEFTCUSTOM + padding + RIGHT, so it is retired as unreproducible rather than adopted, and the band is now asserted so it cannot regress.

GROUP 2, tui.status-row, NEW OPEN GROUP with one item. Baseline at e0987ace was 9 of 9 rows differing; at the tip it is 2 of 11 comparisons. Closed in the same landing: presentation:tui-status-row-colour-encoding (write_ground emits 3n/4n, 9n/10n, 38;5;n and truecolor only for RGB, matching tty_colours_fg through setaf) and presentation:tui-status-row-theme-defaults (TmuxColour::Theme resolves through the dark-theme-* option defaults — yellowgreen 154,205,50 and gray5 13,13,13 for a 256-colour client — instead of colour_theme_table's terminal_colour column). The window_height class was closed by group 1. STILL OPEN, with bytes in the reason: (a) the default status-right shows "bash" where the pin shows "ubuntu", which is #{=21:pane_title}; NOT registered here, it is the panes lane's pane.runtime-facts and the gate re-measures at the merged tip; (b) presentation:tui-status-row-detach-hint, the only registered item: status_overlay writes " Ctrl-\\ detach" over the TAIL of the pin's default status-right, so a stock zz session shows no clock where tmux shows one. Taking a discoverability affordance off every stock attach is a product call nobody handed this lane, so it is measured and left. WIRE-SHAPED RESIDUE recorded in the same reason and NOT attempted: the pin resolves theme colours per client at the server from the `theme` option, the ten dark-theme-*/light-theme-* options and the client's reported background; none of that is on the wire, StatusLine carries base_style unexpanded, so a user-set dark-theme-green or a light terminal is not honoured. The field the daemon would have to publish is the ten resolved colours per client on StatusLine (or an expanded base_style).

GROUP 3, desktop.overlay-consumers, presentation:gui-menu-mouse-policy CLOSED, group STAYS OPEN with a new item. MenuView::pointer feeds every report through zz_client::resolve_menu_mouse; pixels map onto the MenuBox cell frame by measuring the view's own content box with ElementExt::on_prepaint and correcting for both the one cell of content_inset and FloatingSurface's 1px border_1 hairline. Reports the occluding surface never sees arrive through capture-phase handlers on the workspace surface. Four #[gpui::test]s, each sabotage-checked in two runs (dropping the motion handler fails the two highlight/choose tests; dropping the outside routing fails the other two, and made visible that all three reports then reach the terminal pane while a modal menu is drawn). FOUND AND FIXED ON THE WAY: the menu rows were flex_1 and flexbox's automatic minimum size held them at their 16px line height, so a menu whose cell is shorter overflowed the box menu.c sized as count+2 rows and FloatingSurface's overflow_hidden clipped it — three rows drew 48px into a 25px box in the fixture and the third row was unreachable. Rows are one cell now. NEW ITEM presentation:gui-menu-mouse-modality: gpui exposes capture-phase hooks for mouse down and up only, so a motion or a wheel outside the menu still reaches whatever is under it; scrolling a pane under an open menu still scrolls it. Closing that needs a capture-phase move/wheel hook in the carried gpui fork or a mouse layer above the panes, and it is a product question too — not decided here.

ENVIRONMENTAL RED, NOT MINE, and the gate must not chase it: `zz -f <config>` still picks up the invoking user's home settings, and this box's zz settings set base-index 1. cargo test -p zz at my tip is 2 red out of 126 in cli_binary: detached_new_session_prints_default_and_custom_formats (expects formatted/0, gets formatted/1) and control_mode::control_notifications_layout_and_output_follow_the_live_socket_stream (targets watched:0). BOTH PASS on the same commit when the run's HOME is a scratch directory — that is the measurement, and it is recorded in the tui.sidebar-auto-hide resolution. Neither is in my zone (one is control_mode, the wire lane's). Three cli_binary STATUS tests had the same failure and those ARE mine, so they now target the session instead of <session>:0, which is how tmux resolves a session target to its current window; that is why the status tests are green.

ZONE EXCURSIONS: none outside the batch. crates/zz-tui/src/{layout,render,state,app}.rs, crates/zz/src/{command/menu.rs,workspace/view.rs}, crates/zz/tests/cli_binary.rs (status tests plus the two setw retargets described above), crates/zz-client/src/lib.rs (re-export only). compat/ files touched: compat/status-row.sh, compat/tui-pane-geometry.sh, compat/tmux-gaps.json. knowledge/ files touched: knowledge/tmux/gaps.md, regenerated with python3 compat/tmux-tracker.py write-report, never hand-edited. No new scenarios, so compat/results/summary.md is unchanged and compat/run.sh --check-summary prints "summary current: 249 scenarios, 3073 steps; attached-client PASS at 6edc5c7ec425" with only the expected crates/ drift warning.

TWO PRE-EXISTING CONDITIONS ON MAIN, neither introduced here, neither fixed here. (1) rustfmt drift: origin/main is already unformatted in crates/zz/src/workspace/view.rs, crates/zz/src/command/menu.rs, crates/zz/tests/cli_binary.rs, crates/zz/src/mux/client.rs, crates/zz-tui/src/{sidebar,clipboard}.rs and crates/zz-client/src/lib.rs under the pinned 1.97.0 rustfmt. I hand-formatted only MY hunks and left the rest alone so the diff does not collide with the other lanes; `cargo fmt --all` would touch files I do not own. (2) `cargo clippy -p zz-tui --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` fails with ten dead-code errors, all in crates/zz-daemon (lifecycle.rs, paths.rs, transport.rs), because that invocation builds the daemon's lib without its own bins and tests. `cargo clippy -p zz-daemon --all-targets --all-features` is green at my tip and CI's --workspace run is unaffected. zz and zz-client clippy are green.

FLAKES SEEN: none. Every test that failed did so deterministically and for the reasons above. compat/attached-client.sh PASSes at my tip and I did not re-stamp the summary footer.

REGISTRY ACCOUNTING: 15 items across 9 groups at launch becomes 14 across 9 — three proved and removed (two from tui.sidebar-auto-hide, one from desktop.overlay-consumers), tui.sidebar-auto-hide moved to closed[] with closed_on 2026-09-06, one new group tui.status-row with one item, one new item in desktop.overlay-consumers. python3 compat/tmux-tracker.py check is clean at the tip.

pane-runtime-facts.notes:
FINAL TIP c3a66301afe5e417deff1167b3f022a4e325d528 on campaign/batch-pane-runtime-facts, based on e0987ace. origin/main has since gained b0d69603 (crates/zz/src/mux/client.rs) and a7ca9482 (crates/zz/src/config, knowledge/concepts, knowledge/configuration, knowledge/designs, knowledge/tmux/conf-parser.md); neither touches compat/tmux-gaps.json or knowledge/tmux/gaps.md, so the merge should be clean. Four commits: 3d4e4fbc (the group), 1a63611e (hygiene), bb2de04d (repair of my own title seed, see below), c3a66301 (drop a racy scenario row).

PROTOCOL: none. No ProtocolMessage/MuxSnapshot/ClientHello/CommandInvocation/CommandResponse/EventPayload type or field changed, and no enum riding one gained a variant. ONE value-semantics change rides an existing wire field and the integrator should know: TerminalPresentation.working_directory (crates/zz-terminal/src/model.rs, serialized inside TerminalViewport) now carries the OSC 7 payload verbatim instead of a decoded file:// path, because format.c:2331 format_cb_pane_path returns wp->base.path, which screen_set_path stores as clean_name gave it. The type is unchanged, so no bump; no client reads that field (grepped crates/zz/src, crates/zz-tui/src, crates/zz-client/src), the daemon's pane_path fact is the only consumer, and cargo build -p zz-client-ffi plus clippy on zz, zz-client, zz-client-ffi are green.

ZONE EXCURSIONS, all declared: crates/zz-daemon/src/daemon.rs run_shell and if_shell (five inserted-command sites now retarget onto the invoking triple), the two PaneCreated/PaneMaterialized spawn seeds and synchronize_pane_runtime (current path falls back to the start directory), synchronize_pane_title (an empty reported title now returns instead of being written), and one daemon test. Group 5 additionally touched crates/zz-daemon/src/lifecycle.rs, paths.rs and transport.rs, which the group-5 clippy command named.

WHAT WENT IN GROUP 5: nothing was deleted, because nothing was genuinely dead - every item is live under feature "daemon" (and on Windows for the listener half), and zz-tui pulls zz-daemon with default-features off. Gated on the condition its callers already carry: lifecycle.rs IDENTITY_TEMP_SEQUENCE, IdentityRecord::current, IdentityRecord::encode, DaemonIdentityGuard (struct, impl, Drop) and write_identity_atomically on any(feature="daemon", test); paths.rs home_directory (both platform arms) on feature="daemon"; transport.rs Transport::Listener, Transport::bind, trait TransportListener, struct LocalListener and its impl on any(feature="daemon", windows) (askpass.rs and endpoint.rs use them only under cfg(windows)), and TransportStream::shutdown plus LocalStream's override on feature="daemon" (ClientStream has an inherent shutdown that shadows it). Four imports moved behind the same conditions. No allow, no expect, no lint weakened.

REGRESSION I CAUSED AND FIXED, worth a reviewer's eye: my first title fix seeded the pane title from the daemon's PaneCreated effect handling, which runs AFTER the engine has applied split-window -T / select-pane -T. pane-spawn-style-title-v2 caught it (zz answered 1:[ubuntu] where the pin answered 1:[[detached:source-zero:0:1:split-window]]). bb2de04d moves the default to where the pane is born: MuxState carries a default_pane_title that set_format_server_context fills with the server's #{host}, model.rs pane_title uses it for terminal panes (falling back to the old "terminal" when the state has no host, which keeps every engine test that never sets the server context unchanged), and synchronize_pane_title now returns on an empty reported title instead of substituting the default over one somebody chose. The scenario gained a select-pane -T step that proves the async sync no longer clobbers a chosen title. A desktop-visible consequence: a fresh terminal pane's title is now the host name instead of "terminal" for the moment before the shell's OSC 2 arrives.

FLAKY ROW REMOVED: new-window -P -F "#{pane_current_path}|..." was the one differential row that failed on the pre-fix binary, but the pin races on the same read (format_cb_current_path reads a just-forked child that has not chdir'd) and one loaded run had the PIN answer empty where zz answered the directory. c3a66301 cut #{pane_current_path} from that row; it still asserts [#{pane_path}]|#{pane_title}, which was []|terminal pre-fix and []|<HOST> on both after. The current-path seed therefore rests on a throwaway-socket measurement recorded in the closed record: three new-window calls in a row answered the directory, then empty, then empty, and the pane's own first command answered empty; all four answer the directory after. Both facts are in the registry resolution.

PRODUCT DECISION RECORDED (in the closed record, with the required sentence): a default-shell pane on zz runs the bash integration in crates/zz-terminal/assets/shell-integration/bash/zz-integration.bash, whose __zz_title_precmd writes ESC ]2; bash BEL and ESC ]7; file://$HOSTNAME$PWD BEL at every prompt, so such a pane answers #{pane_title} bash and #{pane_path} the reported cwd where the pin, shipping no integration, answers the host name and empty. That is the pin's own rule applied to a pane whose program reports a title and a path, not a mux divergence, and zz keeps the integration because the desktop's tab titles and new-pane directories depend on it. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE PROOF LANE: the acceptance clause asking for a default-shell pane's #T at parity is unprovable as written and is recorded rather than met; the two census-formats remainders pane_path and #T in proofs.census-coverage now have a cause and a stance, and that lane may want to say so there (I did not edit its record).

OTHER FINDINGS recorded in the closed record: an empty OSC 2 payload clears the title on the pin (clean_name returns "" and screen_set_title stores it) and leaves zz's default in place, because libghostty-vt's Terminal::title returns "" both for "never set" and for "cleared" - no probe exercises it. And the neighbouring observation that the stand-in picker's third and fourth commands produced no output on zz did NOT reproduce at this tip: the fpp picker now runs four display-message calls in sequence and both binaries answer all four (ONE|fpp|<DIR>, TWO|0, THREE|fpp-runtime, FOUR|<HOST>); recorded as unreproduced, not fixed.

ENVIRONMENTAL RED THAT IS NOT MINE, and every lane on this box will hit it: with the real HOME, daemon::tests::explicit_boot_configs_replace_default_discovery_and_load_in_order fails deterministically (prefix "C-a" vs "C-x") and three crates/zz/tests/cli_binary.rs tests fail (attached_tui_renders_daemon_authored_styled_status_labels, control_mode::control_notifications_layout_and_output_follow_the_live_socket_stream, detached_new_session_prints_default_and_custom_formats - all base-index shifts, "formatted/1" vs "formatted/0"). The daemon's config discovery and cli_binary's autostarted daemon read the developer's real ~/.tmux.conf. I proved it two ways: the boot-config test fails identically with crates/zz-daemon/src/daemon.rs reverted to origin/main, and all four pass with HOME pointed at a scratch directory. Every test proof above was run with HOME scrubbed for that reason. Also seen once: status::tests::status_command_cache_survives_transient_clients_in_the_same_directory failed under full-suite load ("second" vs "first") and passed twice exact-solo - a load flake outside my diff, worth adding to the known list.

NEW FILES I ADDED (proof lane please note, their summary row is already in compat/results/summary.md): compat/scenarios/smoke/pane-runtime-facts.txt and compat/scenarios/smoke/fixtures/pane-runtime-facts.py. I also edited compat/scenarios/smoke/fixtures/fpp-runtime.py (poll removed, four sequenced picker commands), compat/scenarios/smoke/fixtures/continuum-runtime.py (a second, titleless pane in the save plus field-count and title-column rows) and the header of compat/scenarios/smoke/plugin-runtime-continuum.txt. compat/run.sh --check-summary prints "summary current: 250 scenarios, 3075 steps" plus the expected crates/-drift warning.

The pin has no such threshold at this size." I grepped the whole registry at the tip: that sentence occurs exactly once, in a closed record, and no items[] entry in any group (open or closed) covers it. That is a real product behavior (a zz TUI client drops keypresses once its own output backs up on the master) contradicted against the pin, and the batch prompt's rule is explicit: "Every divergence you discover goes into the durable registry reason with a slug, not only into your report."
